{{Infobox 2on2team |name=DM Riders |team=dmr |color1=0 |color2=10 |flag=eu |image=DMR.jpg |status=Inactive |created=2020 |sponsor= |earnings=Fame & Glory }} == About == '''DM Riders''' is a [[2on2]] team consisting of {{Flag/pt}} [[hammer]] and {{Flag/fr}} [[Bernkaoch]].
This team was created in '''2020''' for the [[Time 2 Hammer Season 2]] QuakeWorld [[2on2]] league.
The name '''DM Riders''' was born by {{Flag/fr}} [[Bernkaoch]] initiative as the team was the underdog on DM maps. == 2020 - 2022== '''[[Time 2 Hammer Season 2]]'''
Against all odds this team took the '''3rd''' place on Veterans Group (division 1).
The only team Defeating [[AeronautS]] in more than one map in '''T2H''' league.
[https://hammer-time.quake1.pl/ Official site here]

'''[[Time 2 Hammer Season 3]]'''
'''3rd''' spot on the group stage, div1 and '''4th''' spot on the playoffs.

'''[[Kombat 2on2on2]]'''
'''2nd''' spot Grand Final. == 2023 == '''[[Time 2 Hammer Season 4]]'''
'''DM RIDERS''' invite {{Flag/pt}} [[Nitemare]] to join for this season.
It surely helped as they took '''3rd''' spot on the div1 group stage, only 1 point behind [[Firing Squad]].
The team took '''3rd''' spot overall on division 1 this season !
